name: RHYSEN
subtitle: Your personal productivity and automation hub.
description: RHYSEN is a personal life management app designed to bring your daily schedule, work and automations into one connected system.

apps.name: RHYSEN
apps.subtitle: Your personal productivity and automation hub.
apps.localizedDescription: RHYSEN brings your daily tasks, work routines, reminders and automations together in one place. Built around a central dashboard, it helps reduce repetitive actions, keep important information accessible and make everyday routines easier to manage.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RHYSEN uses your location to support location-based features and automations.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RHYSEN uses your location in the background to support location-based features and automations.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RHYSEN uses the microphone for voice input.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: RHYSEN uses speech recognition to convert your voice into text.
